author: neal_illustrator
title: Looking for comic and animation artists
content: Heyo! I’m doing an all call looking for artists to help build out my comic and animation teams! I think it’s time to try and ease up some of the stress and expand my team! I’m excited to see y’all’s portfolios! I’m so excited to have the team grow! I’m like a little studio now! Stay stellar!! Application Links are in my linktree (in bio)

author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! OPEN POSITIONS: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Send CV & Portfolio to: harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Nama – Posisi – CV & Portofolio). Open until positions filled.

author: alex.r.gehringer
title: Head of Illustration seeking publishing artists
content: My inbox is now open for queries and portfolio submissions! Artists: As newly appointed Head of Illustration, I’m on the hunt for incredible talent for children’s publishing, YA and adult covers, adult lifestyle and more. Send your portfolio and any concept decks to my inbox. Human work only. AI is not welcome.

author: truchargv
title: Looking for illustrators for content pool
content: We're looking for some incredible artists to join our Illustrator pool! Tap the link in bio to apply! Our illustrator pool is used for articles, newsletters, social media posts etc. Illustrators will be chosen and reached out to as needed.
